title: Static graphic artifacts in the form of dark stripes on the edges of UI elements and sprites
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.3, 4.4 Stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7216) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads)

### Issue description

In the Forward+ and Mobile renderers, when rendering the engine interface and in-game UI elements (for example, health bars), sprites, static thin dark stripes are observed along the edges of these elements. Artifacts do not appear on all elements and are localized in certain areas of the screen, i.e. they appear in the same screen coordinates. The artifacts also depend on the zoom. I scaled the viewport 2D.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/07d63f38-6da1-4934-a04b-f5bda3428889)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a883978c-a8a4-4785-99f2-6d1028b7b4cc)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/da766738-1299-42f2-a74a-5c56c0881e04)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e8036966-2322-475c-9d7c-ed32ea48ca50

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/84138159-cc31-45d2-9ebf-21580c171389

### Steps to reproduce

Create a project with a Forward+ or Mobile renderer. Artifacts are already visible if you look closely.
Additionally, you can create a level stage, place a sprite or a progressbar there, and move them to viewport2D. But you can see it better if you move it during the running game.

[example.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19147561/example.zip)
